qualificationBasis.decision: The maintainer explicitly instructed that MiniMax Code on macOS Intel be marked as having passed acceptance.

acceptance.machineAndExecutionBoundary: Platform admission permits discovery, checks, member selection and execution. Installation, authentication, model selection and live protocol checks retain their existing semantics.

limitations: This artifact records the maintainer's acceptance confirmation. This change does not claim to have run an Intel target-host session or received its detailed checklist, OS build, CLI version, executable fingerprint or raw logs.
The repository's macOS arm64 observations remain separately attributed and do not serve as Intel target-host execution evidence.
Platform admission does not change documented questionnaire cancellation, partial Usage, optional model-probe limitations, unsupported Fast or other capability boundaries.
Windows x64 and Linux x64 remain not qualified; macOS arm64 remains preview.
